sections.prose:
Warrior Discipline: While this model is leading a unit, during you Command Phase, select 1 of the following to be in effect for this model and the unit it is leading until the end of the Battle Round:

  • Gain the Relentless ability
  • Gain the Unyielding ability
  • Gain the Precision ability when making either Ranged or Melee attacks (select 1)
  • Add 1 to Attacks characteristics
  • Add 1 to Weapons Skill characteristics
  • Add 1 to Ballistics Skill characteristics

Alternatively, you can attempt to make this ability Miraculous. To do so, roll a D6. On a 4+ this ability is considered Miraculous. When it is Miraculous, discard up to 3 Miracle Dice and select 1 of ability from the list above to be in effect for each Miracle Dice you discard.

Fury of the Righteous: Once per battle, this model can use this ability when it and a unit it is leading are Activated. When it does so, select either Ranged or Melee attacks as the subject of this ability and discard any number of available Miracle Dice. Those attacks then gain the Sustained Hits [X] ability, where [X] is determined by the number of Miracle Dice discarded. For example, if you discard 2 Miracle Dice for this ability, then these attacks will gain Sustained Hits 2. Torrent weapons instead add [X] to the number of attacks they make. Weapons that already have the Sustained Hits [X] ability instead increase [X] by the number of Miracle Dice discarded.

Retinue: A unit this model is leading can include 1 additional Adeptus Ministorum Character unit (excluding a Canoness) if that Character unit is also able to Lead the unit being led by this model.

Medicus Ministorum: While this model is leading a unit, this model can use this ability. During your Command Phase, roll 1 D6 and return a number of wounds the unit has lost equal to that roll. Alternatively, do not roll a D6 and instead return 2 destroyed non-Character models from the unit to the battlefield.

Sacred Healing: This model can use this ability once per battle. If your Warlord is destroyed, do not remove that Warlord model from the battlefield. Instead, leave it in place (perhaps on its side). In your next Command Phase, if this model is within 6" of your Warlord, it can use this ability to restore up to D3+1 wounds to your Warlord. After using this ability, your Warlord can be replaced on the battlefield and can act normally.

Hymns of Battle: During your Command Phase, you can use this ability. To do so, select one friendly Imperium Infantry unit within 6" of this model and roll a D6. The results of that roll confer the following abilities until the end of the Battle Round:

  • On a 1 or 2, models in that unit add 1 to their Attacks characteristic
  • One a 3 or 4, the above effect occurs and those models also add 1 to their Hit rolls
  • On a 5, the above effects occur, and those models also gain the Fearless ability
  • On a 6, the above effects occur, and those models also increase their Activation Points characteristic by 1
